item: An unreadable imported-events store is kept as calendar_feed_imports.json.damaged before the next save replaces it (R397 b, item 31)
summary: _load_json marks the imports store (by path) when it exists but reads as empty: torn JSON, EIO, a cut character, JSON nested too deeply, or JSON that parses to nothing usable; _save_json then keeps it as <name>.damaged (a hard link, or a move where the drive has none) just before its os.replace, once, never overwriting an earlier copy and never taking a file that replaced the damaged one (identity checked before and after); a passing OSError neither marks nor clears, an empty file is not copied, a healthy read clears the mark; the three rebuilt stores are replaced as before; log lines carry names and the exception class only.
